note: P4389 (Pro 31:12) — she does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

dims.v: steadfast good — doing her husband good, never harm, all her days

the doing of good and not harm to her husband all the days of her life — the steadfast, lifelong benevolence that seeks his welfare constantly, a goodness sustained not for a season but for a whole life
the constant, lifelong good-will that never turns to harm

tob (good) — 'she does him GOOD, and not harm, all the days of her life' (31:12); her benevolence is lifelong and unwavering — not fitful kindness but a settled disposition to seek her husband's good always. Constancy of good-will marks her character.
